# 1 Enoch Chapter 37 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**37:1** This is the second vision of Enoch — a vision of wisdom. Enoch was the son of Jared, son of Mahalalel, son of Cainan, son of Enos, son of Seth, son of Adam.

**37:2** Here begins the wisdom I received, which I now proclaim to all who inhabit the earth: "Listen, all you people of ancient times! And you who come after — pay attention! I am about to speak the words of the Holy One in the presence of the Lord of Spirits."

**37:3** "It would have been better to have shared these things with people of old. But we will not hide the source of wisdom from those yet to come."

**37:4** "To this day, no wisdom like this has ever been granted by the Lord of Spirits to anyone as it has been granted to me — given in keeping with my ability to understand it, and in accordance with the will of the Lord of Spirits, who has also given me a share in eternal life."

**37:5** "Three parables were revealed to me. I raised my voice and spoke them to all who dwell on the earth."

---

*PNEUMA notes: The Parables of Enoch (chs. 37–71) stand apart as the most theologically charged section of 1 Enoch. The divine title "Lord of Spirits" is rendered consistently throughout, as it is the author's signature term for God. "Three parables" refers to the three major units of chs. 38–44, 45–57, and 58–69.*
